title: ADT Employees support Palm Beach County families ahead of Thanksgiving
summary: Just in time for Thanksgiving, Boca Raton, Florida-based ADT employees came together to fill 262 boxes with Thanksgiving meal essentials for local families.
body_markdown:
Just in time for Thanksgiving, Boca Raton, Florida-based ADT employees came together to fill 262 boxes with Thanksgiving meal essentials for local families.


The boxes were donated through Boca Helping Hands’ Thanksgiving Box Brigade, a program that provides Palm Beach County families with a turkey and a box filled with the ingredients needed to prepare a holiday meal.


[ADT](https://www.adt.com/) team members filled the boxes with yams, stuffing, vegetables, cranberry sauce, mashed potatoes, pie ingredients and other holiday staples. The boxes were turned over to Boca Helping Hands for distribution ahead of the holiday.


“Giving back to our community is an important part of[who we are](https://newsroom.adt.com/adt-safe-places) , and as a Boca Raton-based company, it’s especially meaningful to help local families enjoy a Thanksgiving meal,” said Kim Miller, Chief Marketing and Communications Officer at ADT. “I’m grateful to our team members for their generosity and for coming together to support our neighbors this holiday season.”
